name: The Amazing Race Canada
description: A uniquely Canadian take on the original series, with ten teams of two racing around the world to amazing locations for the $1,000,000 prize.

videos.title: The Social - After the Amazing Race Canada
Where In the World is Ogopogo?
videos.overview: Nine teams from across the country arrived at the starting line in Niagara Falls, Ont., by high speed jet boats ready to run “The Amazing Race Canada.”

videos.title: Se Hou Leng
videos.overview: The remaining eight teams race through Vancouver's urban jungle.

videos.title: Hoodoos and Hoodonts
videos.overview: In Calgary, one team steers the others in a different direction; they line up, get knocked down, and face a dirty detour.

videos.title: Grab a Nug
videos.overview: As the contestants travel by land and water across northern Canada, a Speed Bump affects one team in the Yukon.

videos.title: Death by Lentils
videos.overview: The racers head to Regina, Sask., where they are buried in lentils and questioned by the RCMP

videos.title: Check the Cannons!
videos.overview: The remaining teams get tongue-tied and crushed by crepes in Quebec City while the sisters make a costly decision.

videos.title: We Don't Have Time for the Bathroom
videos.overview: The teams head to the frozen climate of Iqaluit, Nunavut; Celina has trouble eating a local delicacy; and the contestants embark on a climb.

videos.title: Clutch and Release
videos.overview: The four remaining teams race into Nova Scotia, where Vanessa and Celina encounter problems, Dave loses patience with Jet and things get intense at the race's second U-Turn.

videos.title: Ah-mazing
videos.overview: The Top 4 teams race to Newfoundland and Labrador.

videos.title: The Family Race Off
videos.overview: The Top 3 teams go to Toronto for the final leg of the race.

videos.title: What's It Take to Get a Cup of Tea?
videos.overview: Eleven new teams begin a race for an unprecedented grand prize.

videos.title: There's a Fish in My Pants
videos.overview: The remaining teams race to Tofino, British Columbia; things turn a little fishy at the detour.

videos.title: Snakes and Liars
videos.overview: The remaining teams are pushed like never before when they travel to Hong Kong, China.

videos.title: They're Harshing Our Mellow
videos.overview: The remaining teams race to Macau, China and face a confusing casino challenge.

videos.title: Who Designs These Torture Tests?
videos.overview: After flying to the Yukon, an Express Pass giveaway causes trouble and one team is sent packing.

videos.title: She's the Pierogi Poobah
videos.overview: The “Race” continues in Winnipeg where teams struggle with scoring goals and channel their inner rock stars at a karaoke challenge.

videos.title: Lest We Forget
videos.overview: The teams horse around in Normandy and take a moment to honour fallen soldiers.

videos.title: I Said Yes!
videos.overview: In romantic Paris, the teams are brought to a standstill at the roadblock

videos.title: How Are We Going to Explain This to Mom and Dad?
videos.overview: The race goes into high gear in Montreal; the teams get confused by a cheesy Detour; the contestants bare it all.

videos.title: Hot Poop
videos.overview: Teams go back in time in Charlottetown; the teams end up in a dead heat.

videos.title: Put the Fun Back in Fundy
videos.overview: The teams face a complex detour as they race to New Brunswick, fighting to be one of the 3 teams in the final leg.

videos.title: Who's Da Bomb?
videos.overview: The final three teams are pushed to their limits in Ottawa and the winning team takes the gold.

videos.title: Who's Feeling Sporty Now
videos.overview: The 12 teams begin their epic journey in front of the Chateau Frontenac in Québec City, then travel to Toronto.

videos.title: We're Going to Dance!
videos.overview: Teams are surprised with an early adventure outside of Canada when they travel to South America. In Santiago, Chile, tensions run high and racers fly higher. Some teams struggle to communicate with the locals, while others express themselves with body language, as they race for a pair of Express passes.

videos.title: I Said Straight, You Gorilla
videos.overview: Teams race to Buenos Aires, Argentina, where racers begin at the Plaza Canada Totem Pole, before getting tripped up on the field in a game of blind soccer.

videos.title: We Know Where They Live
videos.overview: Teams head home to Halifax, where a lost passport puts one team in jeopardy of losing it all.

videos.title: The Face Off
videos.overview: Teams discover one of Québec’s hidden gems, the Magdalen Islands, where they fight to stay afloat in the series’ first ever Face Off challenge.

videos.title: Who Is Alex Trebek?
videos.overview: Teams continue to race to Sudbury, Ontario, where the drama continues, and the trauma gets critical. The Detour forces teams to take the plunge and go deep underground.

videos.title: I Dream About Eating Sandwiches
videos.overview: The Road Block in Saskatoon has some teams bouncing ahead while others fall behind.

videos.title: All of These Are the Same
videos.overview: The remaining teams travel to Kolkata, India, and face chaos in the streets.

videos.title: Take Your Clue and Goooo!
videos.overview: Things get slippery and spicy in Delhi, India for the remaining teams.

videos.title: Man I've Got a Big Butt
videos.overview: A Road Block leaves some of the teams ramped up in Okanagan Valley, British Columbia.

videos.title: Cabotage
videos.overview: The final four teams race to Edmonton where they step back in time and Face Off on the ice.

videos.title: Here's to You, Canada... Cheers
videos.overview: The final three teams race to Vancouver and Whistler and face with the most terrifying challenge ever. The first one to cross the finish line will be crowned the season-three champions.

videos.title: Who's Ready to Let It All Hang Out?
videos.overview: Ten teams begin the adventure of a lifetime in the rugged frontier of The Northwest Territories.

videos.title: Deal Guys? Deal! Deal!
videos.overview: The remaining teams race to downtown Calgary; a detour leaves some of the racers' heads spinning.

videos.title: Toads! Are You Kidding Me?
videos.overview: The remaining teams race to Mekong where they must contend with the heat and culture.

videos.title: Shine Your Light
videos.overview: The teams race through the streets of Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam

videos.title: The Little Blind Tugboat That Could
videos.overview: After returning home to British Columbia, the remaining teams experience Haida Gwaii.

videos.title: Am I Actually Operating the Plane?
videos.overview: The teams fly to Hamilton, Ontario where they receive messages from home.

videos.title: I Could Be Prime Minister
videos.overview: Tensions build as the teams race toward Kingston, Ont.

videos.title: I Just Wanna Win
videos.overview: The remaining teams hit the streets of Havana, Cuba.

videos.title: For Those About to Rock
videos.overview: The teams return to Canada and race through Nova Scotia where a Detour has some teams up in arms.

videos.title: We're Doing It Wrong! We're in Big Trouble
videos.overview: The remaining teams race to Saint John, N.B. where a Detour puts them in a sticky situation.

videos.title: Second Place Isn't Good Enough
videos.overview: The final three teams fly to Montreal and are tested mentally, physically, and emotionally for the final leg.

videos.title: Who Wants to Be the Python?
videos.overview: Ten teams kick off the race at Signal Hill National Historic Site and travel to Vancouver.

videos.title: You've Got to Leave My Hose Alone Dude!
videos.overview: The teams race to Fort McMurray, Alta., where some start to feel the pressure with three express passes up for grabs.

videos.title: It's Like Ducks in the Forest
videos.overview: The teams race to Castlegar, B.C., where grueling challenges lead some teams to spiral out of control with three Express Passes in play.

videos.title: This Is a Butt Workout
videos.overview: In Beijing, some Racers find themselves lost in translation on the Great Wall of China, while others consider throwing in the towel.

videos.title: This Is a Real Cat and Mouse Chase
videos.overview: The Race continues through Shanghai, China, and Bangkok, Thailand, where a Detour has Racers struggling to hang loose.

videos.title: We Just Saw Johnny Mustard
videos.overview: The teams head to Ottawa, where a citizenship test has some Racers struggling to make the grade and it's a fight for first to the Double U-Turn.

videos.title: Break Time for Korey
videos.overview: The Race heads back to Newfoundland and Labrador, where alliances crumble, tensions boil, and the teams are faced with the first face-off of the season.

videos.title: Can I See Your Kuna?
videos.overview: The teams head south to Panama City where a Detour has some teams letting loose, and a Roadblock has Racers feeling colour blind.

videos.title: It's Like Finding Waldo in a Bunch of Waldos
videos.overview: The teams face a detour in Regina; the odds are stacked against some teams.

videos.title: They're Crawling on You
videos.overview: The remaining teams travel to Sault Ste. Marie, where some struggle to jump through hoops, and the final four face their fears.

videos.title: Canada's Coming Together Like a Piece of Cake
videos.overview: The final three teams race to the finish line.

videos.title: Just a Beaver Hero
videos.overview: The “Heroes edition” of the Race begins with 10 teams of Canadian heroes at Hatley Castle in Colwood, Victoria.

videos.title: Fiddler's Fart
videos.overview: The remaining teams head North to Dawson City, Yukon where 3 Express Passes are up for grabs.

videos.title: Sounds Like a Wild Boar
videos.overview: The teams head to Salt Spring Island, B.C., where they face a speedy Roadblock.

videos.title: Just Suck My Blood Please
videos.overview: The teams head to Jakarta, Indonesia where they face a blind Double U-Turn.

videos.title: You Gotta Whip That Cream
videos.overview: The teams return to Canada to duel in Stratford, Ontario.

videos.title: Smells Like Sweat and Fun
videos.overview: The teams keep racing and join the masses in Toronto, where a roadblock has teams trying to get ahead of the pack.

videos.title: Poodle Time
videos.overview: The remaining teams travel to Winnipeg, where they attempt to hit the bullseye in a Face Off.

videos.title: The Zombies Are Honing in on Us
videos.overview: The remaining teams head east to Prince Edward Island.

videos.title: The Battle of the Two Courtneys
videos.overview: The remaining teams head to Mexico City, where they act out.

videos.title: The Plan Is Simple. Win!
videos.overview: The remaining 4 teams return to Canada to compete for a spot in the finale.

videos.title: The Summer of Heroes
videos.overview: The three remaining teams race to the finish line in the hope of claiming victory.

videos.title: Canada Get More Maps
videos.overview: The Amazing Race Canada returns for Season 7 as nine new teams join Canada’s Choice Jet and Dave at the starting line in Toronto.

videos.title: Our Competition's Not That Smart
videos.overview: Teams race to Revelstoke, B.C., where some wipe out and others find themselves halted on the track to the pit stop.

videos.title: We'll Let the Peasants Fight for Last Place
videos.overview: In Edmonton, some teams get blindsided by the first-ever One Way.

videos.title: I Love Geologists
videos.overview: The teams travel to Yellowknife, where racers feel the pressure of a diamond road block before things take a chilling turn

videos.title: Clamageddon Continues
videos.overview: Teams head southwest to Nanaimo, B.C., where they take their fears to new heights and are challenged during a search on the beach.

videos.title: I'm a Little Muskrat on a Mission
videos.overview: The race leads to Saskatoon, where some teams find themselves stuck and others dance around the problem.

videos.title: Balls, Balls, Balls
videos.overview: Teams head to Kitchener-Waterloo, Ont., where the season’s first face-off forces racers to prove that they’re best in class

videos.title: Open Your Bouche
videos.overview: Teams travel to Charlevoix, Que., where some racers get tongue-tied under pressure.

videos.title: Another Day in Thunder Bay
videos.overview: Racers head to Thunder Bay, Ont., where a Face Off makes teams realize it could be anybody’s game.

videos.title: He's Basically a Hound
videos.overview: The final four teams head east to Wolfville, Nova Scotia, and the Annapolis Valley, where they compete for a spot in the Season 7 finale.

videos.title: I Had ONE Job
videos.overview: The final three teams race to the finish line in Muskoka, Ont. in hopes of winning Season 7 of The Amazing Race Canada.

videos.title: Come On, Doodlebug
videos.overview: On the season premiere, 10 new teams embark on an epic adventure that could change their lives forever.

videos.title: Goatageddon
videos.overview: Teams race to Lethbridge, Alta., where some decide to give a hoot, while others follow the herd.

videos.title: We Love Weenies!
videos.overview: Racers make their way to Fernie, B.C., where they must choose between learning to fly or ready to roll.

videos.title: Feel the Fear and Do It Anyways
videos.overview: Teams head to Canmore, Alberta, where they must race the rapids before hitting the ranch for a test of skill and stamina.

videos.title: I'm a Human Kite
videos.overview: Teams jet off to Kelowna, B.C., where they take their fears to great heights and set their sights on a new target.

videos.title: Racing for Our Lives
videos.overview: Racers head to London, Ont. where they choose between aviation or animation, before they are joined by some furry friends.

videos.title: What the Duck Is Going On?
videos.overview: Teams make their way to Prince Edward County, Ont. where a shocking surprise sends the racers reeling.

videos.title: Give Me a Moustache and Call Me Sherlock Holmes
videos.overview: Teams travel to Ottawa and Gatineau, Que., where the season’s first Face Off quickly reveals that this is still anybody’s game.

videos.title: I Love You. I Know.
videos.overview: Racers jet off to Bathurst, N.B., where they put their footwork to the test; some realize they might not be doing as ‘well’ as they thought.

videos.title: Is That a Wild Peacock?
videos.overview: The remaining teams head to Tobermory, Ont. and the Bruce Peninsula, where they compete for a spot in the finale.

videos.title: Where Is Gurmail
videos.overview: On the season finale, the final teams are pushed to the limit to earn the coveted title of THE AMAZING RACE CANADA champions.

videos.title: I Hate Pancakes
videos.overview: An epic race throughout Canada begins, as 10 teams embark on the adventure of a lifetime. Starting in Winnipeg, before heading to Calgary, racers face their first challenges as they compete to be first at the mat.

videos.title: My First Experience
videos.overview: Racers wade into Smithers, B.C., where some have a smooth delivery and others struggle with the details.

videos.title: Bribery Always Works
videos.overview: Racers head to Whistler and Pemberton, B.C., where some take a leap and others take a plunge.

videos.title: This Ugly Duckling Is Now a Swan
videos.overview: In Victoria, B.C., teams strive for precision during the first Face Off and try to avoid making a splash while balancing in the ocean.

videos.title: This Is Not a Hot Girl Moment
videos.overview: Teams travel to Tofino and Ucluelet, B.C., where things get icy before they take a dive.

videos.title: This Is Going to Be a Spicy Leg
videos.overview: The race heads east to Niagara-on-the-Lake, Ont., where a roadblock has teams revved up and they try to sniff out a win.

videos.title: I'm Sick of Wearing Neon
videos.overview: Teams slip and slide in Windsor Ont., and must hold’em or fold’em in a high stakes Face Off.

videos.title: I Should Have Made Snowmen
videos.overview: Teams travel to Saguenay, QC, where things get rocky as racers hang on for a spot in the semi-finals.

videos.title: Light the Candle
videos.overview: The teams make their way to Toronto, where after the opening bell, racers are faced with a tough climb.

videos.title: Do You Want Some Candies
videos.overview: The Race continues in Toronto, where the remaining teams compete for a coveted spot in the Season 9 finale.

videos.title: It's Zebra Time
videos.overview: The last remaining teams face an intense final race to the finish line, as they defy gravity to hit a target and square off.

videos.title: Back Where It All Started
videos.overview: The milestone tenth season returns to where it all began, as 11 teams embark on the adventure of a lifetime.

videos.title: Call Me the Olive Man
videos.overview: Teams head west to the Sunshine Coast, B.C., and decide whether to secure their spot or try for an opportunity to get ahead.

videos.title: Plot Twist It's a U-Turn Vote
videos.overview: Faced with the first-ever U-Turn Vote, alliances are formed and threatened as some teams realize they're being played.

videos.title: Slow Roll and Stay in Control
videos.overview: In Penticton, B.C., the drama from the U-Turn Vote unfolds when the results are revealed, and another twist leaves everyone shocked.

videos.title: I Smell Like Carcass
videos.overview: Teams head to Regina, Sask. before 'The Amazing Race Canada' touches down in host Jon Montgomery’s hometown of Russell, Man.

videos.title: Caution Double Pass Ahead
videos.overview: The Race heads east to Guelph and Wellington County, Ont., where teams first take a moment to reflect before getting boosted 90 feet up a limestone quarry.

videos.title: When Am I Going to See My Dog Next?
videos.overview: Tensions are high during a Face Off as teams sweep into a Switch Back in Trois-Rivieres, Que. The detour leaves some tongue tied, while others get into a paper jam. At the roadblock teams struggle to hold their horses.

videos.title: Manure Time Baby!
videos.overview: The Race continues in Cornwall, Ontario and reaches a fever pitch before alpaca poop hits the fan and a Detour leaves racers off-kilt; it's game on as teams bank on scoring a spot in the semi-final.

videos.title: Where Are You Mr. Oyster
videos.overview: Racers make waves on the East Coast and try to zip through the competition in Miramichi, New Brunswick; the heat is on as the remaining teams try to earn their way into a coveted spot on the season ten finale.

videos.title: Bark If You See 'Em
videos.overview: The final four teams rev up in Edmonton for a showdown; they face twists and turns and a chance to make a giant leap towards the finish line.

videos.title: Canada Is Something Special
videos.overview: Eleven new teams begin the adventure of a lifetime as "The Amazing Race Canada" returns to where last season's winners were crowned.

videos.title: I'd Hug You But I Smell
videos.overview: Racers travel to Lake Louise, Alberta and Golden, British Columbia, and must pick wisely to not get frozen out of the search.

videos.title: Those Little Sneaky Susans
videos.overview: The race heads to the Fraser Valley in B.C. where everyone has to hit the right notes, and a Face Off leaves one team in the penalty box.

videos.title: There's Two Joes
videos.overview: The Amazing Race Canada travels to Inuvik and Tuktoyaktuk, Northwest Territories, reaching the Arctic Ocean for the first time.

videos.title: Prince George in the House
videos.overview: Teams land in Prince George, B.C. where they see green before making a splash. Plus, the Double Blind Pass returns.

videos.title: I Am A Goat
videos.overview: Racers head to Sherbrooke and the Eastern Townships, Que. for a Gladiator style Face Off and a Roadblock that defies the laws of physics.

videos.title: Cheer Up Buttercup You're With a Donkey
videos.overview: Teams travel to Gananoque, Ont. and the 1000 Islands; racers face a high-flying technical challenge; a roadblock combines hoof with haute couture.

videos.title: I'm Just Practicing Falling
videos.overview: Tensions rise and fears are tested as teams race through Mississauga, Ontario and face a heart-pounding skyscraper traverse high above the city skyline.

videos.title: We're Full Of Moose Farts
videos.overview: The Race continues in St. John's and Gander, Nfld., where the remaining teams compete for a coveted spot in the Season 11 finale.

videos.title: I Crave That Clutch
videos.overview: On the high-stakes season finale, the final teams head to Collingwood, Ont. for a double Roadblock and chance to jetsurf their way to victory!

videos.title: Express Pass? Let's Go!!!
videos.overview: Ten teams begin the adventure of a lifetime as the Race kicks off atop Whistler Mountain in British Columbia. Racers are faced with one of the biggest twists in game history when every team is surprised with an Express Pass – a game-changing advantage that dramatically shifts the strategy of the Race right from the beginning.

videos.title: Is This Your Poo?
videos.overview: Teams head to Kelowna, British Columbia, where they hit the slopes before tackling an unexpected challenge: collecting kangaroo droppings. With the dirty work behind them, racers put their memory skills to the test by learning the Syilx Okanagan people’s 13-moon cycles of the year, before closing out the leg by assembling a complex irrigation system. But with physical endurance and mental sharpness tested at every turn, which teams will rise to the challenge—and which will fall behind?

videos.title: We're Here, Baby, We're Trying to Win
videos.overview: Teams travel to Falkland, B.C., and Jasper, Alta., where a Detour provides an opportunity to assist with rebuilding efforts following the devastating 2024 Jasper wildfires.

videos.title: Our Taxi Left Us
videos.overview: In Montréal and Laval, Quebec, teams face a game-changing Roadblock that introduces The Intersection - forcing two teams to work together.

videos.title: A Real Eager Beaver
videos.overview: A season-altering U-Turn Vote sparks strategic chaos as teams race through Peterborough and the Kawarthas, but first, a three-part challenge inspired by classic Canadian cottage games. Next, the Canadian Canoe Museum sets the stage for a demanding Detour that tests racers’ attention to detail inside the museum’s world-renowned collection of canoes or paddling precision on the water. The pressure continues at the Ontario Turtle Conservation Centre, where teams help care for rescued snapping turtles before heading to Bobcaygeon, Ont. to deliver iconic summer snacks to destinations across the town’s islands. As the competition reaches its midpoint, teams race to the historic Trent-Severn Waterway in Buckhorn, Ont. where one team’s journey may come to an end.
